questions.question: At which Olympics was Kho-Kho featured in an exhibition in the main stadium?
questions.questionHtml: At which Olympics was Kho-Kho featured in an exhibition in the main stadium?
questions.solution: Kho-Kho was featured in an exhibition at the main stadium during the 1936 Olympics held in Berlin, Germany. This exhibition aimed to showcase traditional sports from different countries, with Kho-Kho representing India. Although not an official Olympic sport, this provided international exposure for Kho-Kho. The 1936 Olympics are also notable for the political context and Nazi propaganda, as well as Jesse Owens' four gold medals which challenged racial superiority claims.

questions.question: The first modern Olympic Games was held in the year ______.
questions.questionHtml: The first modern Olympic Games was held in the year ______.
questions.solution: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) was founded in 1894, and it was decided that the first modern Olympic Games would be held two years later in Athens, Greece. The first modern Olympic Games were held from April 6 to April 15, 1896, and featured 14 nations and 241 athletes competing in 43 events.The Games were a huge success and helped to revive the ancient tradition of Olympic competition, which had been dormant for more than 1,500 years.

questions.question: The Walker Cup is associated with which of the following sports?
questions.questionHtml: The Walker Cup is associated with which of the following sports?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is golf.

Key Points

  • Walker Cup is a golf trophy awarded to the winner of a competition between amateur men’s teams from the United States and the British Isles.
  • The cup is named for George H. Walker, a president of the United States Golf Association (USGA) in the 1920s and a primary organizer of the event.
  • The cup has been held biennially since 1922 at alternating sites between the United States and Britain.​

questions.question: When was the ﬁrst Common Wealth Games held?
questions.questionHtml: When was the ﬁrst Common Wealth Games held?
questions.solution:
The first Common Wealth Games was held in the year 1930.

  • Earlier the game was known as the British Empire Games.
  • It was held in 1930 in Hamilton, Ontario.
  • Since then it held at every fourth year.
  • The next Commonwealth Games would be held in Birmingham from 27 July to 7 August 2022.

questions.question: Who is the first Indian to have won an individual Olympic gold medal?
questions.questionHtml: Who is the first Indian to have won an individual Olympic gold medal?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Abhinav Bindra.

Key Points

  • Abhinav Bindra collects the gold medal for India in the men's 10m air rifle shooting competition.
  • Bindra captures India's first individual gold medal in Shooting 10m Air Rifle Final Men - Beijing.

Important Points

  • At the Sydney 2000 Olympic Games, weightlifter Karnam Malleswari marked her place in Olympic and Indian sports history.
  • She took the bronze medal and became India’s first woman to win an Olympic medal.
  • Leander Paes is an Indian tennis player who was one of the most successful doubles players in tennis history,
    • With 8 career Grand Slam doubles titles and 10 career Grand Slam mixed doubles championships.
    • In 1996 when he took the men’s singles tennis bronze medal at the Atlanta Olympic Games, he became the first Indian athlete since 1952 to win an individual Olympic medal.
  • PV Sindhu defeated He Bing Jiao in straight games to clinch the bronze medal at the Tokyo Games and become the first Indian woman to win two individual Olympic medals.
  • After becoming the first Indian female athlete to win a Silver medal at the Olympics in Rio in 2016 PV Sindhu has become only the 2nd Indian athlete after Sushil Kumar to win 2 individual medals at the Games.
  • PV Sindhu: Achievements
    • In January 2020, PV Sindhu was awarded the Third-Highest Civilian Award in India- Padma Bhushan.
    • In March 2015, Sindhu was awarded the Fourth Highest Civilian Award in India- Padma Shri. 
    • In August 2016, she was awarded the Highest Sporting Honour of India- Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna.
    • In September 2013, PV Sindhu was awarded the Arjuna Award for outstanding performance in sports. etc.
